requirements.definition: The ENCODING= scalar default character expression shall evaluate to UTF-8 or DEFAULT.

requirements.title: ENCODING= is not permitted for unformatted input/output connections
requirements.definition: The ENCODING= specifier is permitted only for a connection for formatted input/output, so it is not permitted for an unformatted connection.

requirements.title: A UTF-8 encoded file is a Unicode file with ISO 10646 characters
requirements.definition: A file with ENCODING=UTF-8 is called a Unicode file, and all characters therein are of ISO 10646 character kind.

requirements.title: Omitted ENCODING= defaults to DEFAULT
requirements.definition: If ENCODING= is omitted in an OPEN statement that initiates a connection, the default value is DEFAULT.

pending.encoding-omitted-default-default: Source-derived no-oracle plan for the DEFAULT token: although 12.5.6.9 fixes the omitted OPEN ENCODING= value as DEFAULT, 12.10.2.10 INQUIRE(ENCODING=) reports encoding form properties (UTF-8 for a formatted UTF-8 connection, UNDEFINED for an unformatted connection, and UNKNOWN only in the no-connection/undetermined cases), not the OPEN DEFAULT token. Use a formatted connection to avoid the unformatted UNDEFINED case, but no portable single-image observation distinguishes the DEFAULT token itself or the processor-dependent encoding form selected by it.
